claim: Delta(G) is clause-minimally UNSAT iff G is 4-critical; on odd wheel W_h each of m=7h+1 clauses has an opposite-label one-sign-word perturbation.
model: canonical mixed 2/3-CNF, four words per clause, addressed-word reads cost 1
lower_bound: T_A(Delta(W_h)) >= m=(N/w-2)/4 = Omega(N/log N), word-probe model only
counterexample: odd wheels have minimum direct-assignment 2-CNF backdoor k=h+1 but linear canonical decision and width-three graph decomposition
